shared_history_rule: This same mathematical approach is shared with both broader targets; editorial preparation adds zero approaches.
approach: Discrete incidence bounds, finite-plane completion and degree-excess reduction
main_scope: All fields; distinct projective lines; every singular point included; only the original stated prime-power bands.
residual_condition: A counterexample must be a realizable nondegenerate finite linear space with v=q^2-a, b=q^2+q, maximum block size q and positive integer total degree excess delta. Necessary bounds do not establish existence or realizability.
